# HingeConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HingeConstraint")`

A joint that lets two parts rotate about one axis, such as a door, a lid or an elbow. The axis is the X axis of the attachments, so rotating an attachment aims the hinge.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType.None` | read/write | Whether the hinge drives itself. `None` does nothing, `Motor` turns at a constant speed, and `Servo` turns to an angle and holds it. |
| `AngularResponsiveness` | `number` | `45` | read/write | For `Servo`: how quickly the hinge closes the last of the distance to its target, as a frequency in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. The hinge arrives without overshooting. The value is tuned for the two parts the hinge connects; if more parts hang from the joint, set `Stiffness` instead. |
| `AngularSpeed` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | For `Servo`: the highest speed the hinge turns at on its way to the target, in radians per second. Near the target, the spring takes over. |
| `AngularVelocity` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Motor`: the speed the hinge turns at, in radians per second about its X axis. A negative value turns the other way. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: how strongly the hinge resists turning, in newton meter seconds per radian. Used together with `Stiffness`. Critical damping, which reaches the target without overshooting, is `2 * math.sqrt(Stiffness * I)` for a moment of inertia of `I`. Less overshoots and oscillates; more arrives slowly. |
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `LowerAngle` and `UpperAngle` apply. When it is off, the hinge turns freely. |
| `LowerAngle` | `number` | `-180` | read/write | The lower limit of the hinge's rotation, in degrees. |
| `MotorMaxAcceleration` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | For `Motor`: how quickly the motor's speed can change, in radians per second squared. A low value makes the motor wind up slowly, like a fan. |
| `MotorMaxTorque` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | For `Motor`: the largest torque the motor can apply, in newton meters. A load that needs more than this stalls the motor. |
| `ServoMaxTorque` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | For `Servo`: the largest torque the servo can apply to reach its target and hold it, in newton meters. A load that needs more than this pulls the hinge away from its target. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: the strength of the spring that pulls the hinge to its target, in newton meters per radian. At 0, `AngularResponsiveness` is used instead. Above 0, this and `Damping` set the response. For a load with a moment of inertia of `I` kilogram square meters, `w * w * I` gives a response of `w` radians per second. |
| `TargetAngle` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: the angle the hinge turns to, in degrees, measured the same way as the limits. Speeds, by contrast, are in radians per second. |
| `UpperAngle` | `number` | `180` | read/write | The upper limit of the hinge's rotation, in degrees. If `LowerAngle` is greater than `UpperAngle`, the hinge is not limited. |
